caption: Right after the install the app said Successfully installed, with no charge screen on our development store. The store name is hidden.
The earning rule Place an order, 4 points per 1USD spent, was active about 3 minutes after the install. The other earning rules stay off until you switch them on. The store name is hidden.
Pricing is per plugin and flat per month: Wishlist runs from Free (100 orders) to $10, $20 and $40, with a 14 day trial on the first paid plan. The store name is hidden.

Adding Loyalty Advanced to free Wishlist made Shopify ask for $10 every 30 days after a 14 day trial, plus taxes. Approve stayed greyed out without a payment method, and we cancelled. The store name is hidden.
Uninstalling deletes data the app manages, such as discounts. We opened the dialog to check and cancelled. The store name is hidden.
